mentions.name: Right Words
mentions.description: A twice-weekly word puzzle web game where players trace two-word phrases on a grid by finding a path with exactly one gap (the space between words), described as NYT Strands but with a jump. Built with React and TypeScript, deployed on Vercel with no backend, with puzzles stored as JSON. Puzzle generation packs multiple snaking paths onto a grid like jigsaw pieces, constrained so each answer has exactly one valid path.
mentions.source_excerpt: I made Right Words (https://www.rightwords.io/) a fun little solo project, tl;dr it's a twice weekly word puzzle where you trace two-word phrases on a grid by finding a path with exactly one gap (the space between words). Think NYT Strands but with a jump!
